async {
    use ::marigold::marigold_impl::*;
    const fn inc(x: i32) -> i32 { x + 1 }

const fn name(x: i32) -> String { format!("n{x}") }

let mut xs = {use ::marigold::marigold_impl::*; ::marigold::marigold_impl::multi_consumer_stream::MultiConsumerStream::new(::marigold::marigold_impl::futures::stream::iter(0..5).map(inc))};

let mut ys = {use ::marigold::marigold_impl::*; ::marigold::marigold_impl::multi_consumer_stream::MultiConsumerStream::new(xs.get().map(name))};

let non_returning_stream_0 = Box::pin({use ::marigold::marigold_impl::*; {
            if let Some(parent) = ::std::path::Path::new("a.csv").parent() {
              ::marigold::marigold_impl::tokio::fs::create_dir_all(parent)
                .await
                .expect("could not create parent directory for output file");
            }

            static WRITER: ::marigold::marigold_impl::once_cell::sync::OnceCell<
              ::marigold::marigold_impl::tokio::sync::Mutex<
                ::marigold::marigold_impl::csv_async::AsyncSerializer<
                  ::marigold::marigold_impl::tokio_util::compat::Compat<
                    ::marigold::marigold_impl::writer::Writer
                  >
                >
              >
            > = ::marigold::marigold_impl::once_cell::sync::OnceCell::new();

            WRITER.set(
              ::marigold::marigold_impl::tokio::sync::Mutex::new(
                ::marigold::marigold_impl::csv_async::AsyncSerializer::from_writer(
                  ::marigold::marigold_impl::writer::Writer::file(
                    ::marigold::marigold_impl::tokio::fs::File::create("a.csv")
                       .await
                       .expect("Could not write to file")
                  )
                  .compat_write()
                )
              )
            ).expect("Could not put CSV writer into OnceCell");

            let mut stream_to_write =

           xs.get()
              ;
              stream_to_write.filter_map(
                |v| async move {
                  WRITER
                    .get()
                    .expect("Could not get CSV writer from OnceCell")
                    .lock()
                    .await
                    .serialize(v)
                    .await
                    .expect("could not write record to CSV");
                  None
                }
              ).chain(
                // after the stream is complete, flush the writer.
                ::marigold::marigold_impl::futures::stream::iter(0..1)
                  .filter_map(|_v| async {
                      let mut serializer_guard = WRITER
                        .get() // gets Mutex<...>
                        .expect("Could not get CSV writer from OnceCell")
                        .lock()
                        .await;
                      let mut serializer = std::mem::replace(
                        &mut *serializer_guard,
                        ::marigold::marigold_impl::csv_async::AsyncSerializer::from_writer(
                            ::marigold::marigold_impl::writer::Writer::vector()
                              .compat_write()
                        )
                      );
                      serializer
                        .into_inner()
                        .await
                        .expect("Could not get underlying writer from serializer")
                        .get_mut()
                        .shutdown()
                        .await
                        .expect("Could not shut down underlying writer");
                      None
                  })
              )
          }});
let non_returning_stream_1 = Box::pin({use ::marigold::marigold_impl::*; {
            if let Some(parent) = ::std::path::Path::new("b.csv").parent() {
              ::marigold::marigold_impl::tokio::fs::create_dir_all(parent)
                .await
                .expect("could not create parent directory for output file");
            }

            static WRITER: ::marigold::marigold_impl::once_cell::sync::OnceCell<
              ::marigold::marigold_impl::tokio::sync::Mutex<
                ::marigold::marigold_impl::csv_async::AsyncSerializer<
                  ::marigold::marigold_impl::tokio_util::compat::Compat<
                    ::marigold::marigold_impl::writer::Writer
                  >
                >
              >
            > = ::marigold::marigold_impl::once_cell::sync::OnceCell::new();

            WRITER.set(
              ::marigold::marigold_impl::tokio::sync::Mutex::new(
                ::marigold::marigold_impl::csv_async::AsyncSerializer::from_writer(
                  ::marigold::marigold_impl::writer::Writer::file(
                    ::marigold::marigold_impl::tokio::fs::File::create("b.csv")
                       .await
                       .expect("Could not write to file")
                  )
                  .compat_write()
                )
              )
            ).expect("Could not put CSV writer into OnceCell");

            let mut stream_to_write =

           ys.get()
              ;
              stream_to_write.filter_map(
                |v| async move {
                  WRITER
                    .get()
                    .expect("Could not get CSV writer from OnceCell")
                    .lock()
                    .await
                    .serialize(v)
                    .await
                    .expect("could not write record to CSV");
                  None
                }
              ).chain(
                // after the stream is complete, flush the writer.
                ::marigold::marigold_impl::futures::stream::iter(0..1)
                  .filter_map(|_v| async {
                      let mut serializer_guard = WRITER
                        .get() // gets Mutex<...>
                        .expect("Could not get CSV writer from OnceCell")
                        .lock()
                        .await;
                      let mut serializer = std::mem::replace(
                        &mut *serializer_guard,
                        ::marigold::marigold_impl::csv_async::AsyncSerializer::from_writer(
                            ::marigold::marigold_impl::writer::Writer::vector()
                              .compat_write()
                        )
                      );
                      serializer
                        .into_inner()
                        .await
                        .expect("Could not get underlying writer from serializer")
                        .get_mut()
                        .shutdown()
                        .await
                        .expect("Could not shut down underlying writer");
                      None
                  })
              )
          }});
let stream_variable_runners_0 = Box::pin({
                let runner_future = Box::pin(xs.run());
                ::marigold::marigold_impl::multi_consumer_stream::RunFutureAsStream::new(runner_future)
            });
let stream_variable_runners_1 = Box::pin({
                let runner_future = Box::pin(ys.run());
                ::marigold::marigold_impl::multi_consumer_stream::RunFutureAsStream::new(runner_future)
            });
let streams_array:  Vec<core::pin::Pin<Box<dyn futures::Stream<Item=()>>>> = vec![
non_returning_stream_0,
non_returning_stream_1,
stream_variable_runners_0,
stream_variable_runners_1,
]
;let mut all_streams = ::marigold::marigold_impl::futures::stream::select_all(streams_array);all_streams.collect::<Vec<()>>().await;
}
